ideas.name: The eight CTE areas and two streams

en.text: Ethiopia has eight CTE occupational areas. Natural science areas are manufacturing, agriculture, construction, information technology and health sciences. Business science is in the social science stream. Language and social sciences, and performing and visual arts, complete the eight. You study them in detail in Grades 11 and 12.

screens.title: Jobs in your locality
screens.ask: Where could people in your area get jobs for a living?
opts: Farming, shops, building, health centres, hotels and more
screens.after: People work in many areas. Ethiopia groups this work into eight CTE areas.

screens.title: 2.1 CTE areas in Ethiopia
paras: The CTE program in Ethiopia has eight occupational areas.
Each area has sub-specializations.
You will learn them in detail in Grades 11 and 12.

screens.title: Two streams
paras: Secondary school CTE programs are in two streams: natural sciences and social sciences.
Natural science deals with the physical world: physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics.
Social science studies human society: economics, politics, history, geography, civics.
table: Manufacturing, agriculture, construction, information technology, health sciences
Business sciences (accounting, banking and insurance, marketing, office management, hotel and tourism)

screens.text: How many CTE occupational areas does Ethiopia have?
screens.clue: Count the areas in the tree.

screens.why: Manufacturing, agriculture, construction, IT and health are natural science areas. Business is social science.
screens.clue: Is it about the physical world or about society?

screens.text: Natural science includes physics, chemistry, biology and mathematics.
screens.why: That is how the book describes natural science.

screens.text: Liya loves accounting and hotel work. Mekdes loves fixing computers. Which streams fit them best?
opts: Liya: social sciences; Mekdes: natural sciences
Liya: natural sciences; Mekdes: social sciences
screens.ans: Liya: social sciences; Mekdes: natural sciences

screens.clue: Match each interest to its CTE area, then to its stream.

en.text: Manufacturing turns raw materials into finished goods, like sugarcane into sugar. Construction builds and repairs buildings, roads and bridges. IT uses computers to handle data. Agriculture grows plants and livestock. Health science applies science to health. Business science is about selling goods and services. Language and social sciences use language and help communities. Performing and visual arts include music, theatre and painting.

screens.title: From cane to sugar
screens.ask: Sugarcane goes into a factory and comes out as sugar. Which CTE area is this?
screens.after: Changing raw material into a finished product is manufacturing.

screens.title: 1. Manufacturing
paras: Manufacturing is producing goods with labour, machines, tools and chemical or biological processes.
It transforms raw materials into finished goods.
Sugarcane becomes sugar. Cotton becomes your sweater in a textile factory.
table: Metal sheets, bolts, wires, jewellery, grinding mill parts
Cars, tractors, buses; repairing engines, wheels, brakes
Clothes and threads from fibres; shoes from leather
Tables, chairs, beds, doors from timber

screens.title: 2. Construction and 3. Information technology
paras: Construction plans, builds, repairs and demolishes buildings, bridges, roads and railways.
Its areas: electricity, plumbing, carpentry and building finishing works.
Information technology uses computers and networks to create, store and exchange electronic data.
Its areas: computer maintenance and network, website design, computer graphics design.

screens.title: 4. Agriculture and 5. Health sciences
paras: Agriculture is cultivating plants and livestock.
It includes crops, poultry, fattening, flowers, forestry and soil protection.
Health science applies science to health: medicine, nutrition, personal and community health.
Doctors, nurses, laboratory technicians and pharmacists are health professionals.

screens.title: 6. Business, 7. Language and social sciences, 8. Arts
paras: Business science covers accounting, marketing, banking, insurance, office management, and hotel and tourism.
Language and social sciences cover writing, translation, social work, anthropology and citizenship.
Performing and visual arts include music, dance, theatre, film, painting and sculpture.
Ethiopian instruments include the kirar, masinqo and dinke.

screens.why: Each job belongs to one CTE area.
screens.clue: Think: what is the work about?

screens.text: In making a cotton sweater, what is the raw material?
screens.why: The raw material is what the product is made from.

screens.text: Which is a main activity of banks?
screens.why: Banking is the use of banks for keeping, withdrawing and borrowing money.
The maresha, sickle and traditional beehive are traditional. Tractors and pumps are modern.
screens.clue: Which ones were used long ago?

screens.text: A carpenter makes a table. Then she polishes and varnishes it. Which two areas of construction does this show?
screens.why: Cutting and shaping wood is carpentry. Polishing and varnishing are finishing works, the last stage.
screens.clue: What is the last stage of making something called?

items.why: Tractors, drip irrigation and improved seeds are modern; the hoe and plough are traditional.

items.text: Tap every good advice to prevent the spread of COVID-19.
pool: Cover your cough with your elbow
a: Cover your cough with your elbow

test.text: Which is a CTE area in Ethiopia?
test.why: Agriculture is one of the eight areas.

test.text: Wood work technology is part of manufacturing.
test.why: It is one of the four manufacturing sub-specializations.

test.text: Electricians, plumbers and carpenters work in which area?
Business science belongs to which stream?
test.why: The book places business sciences in the social science stream.

test.text: A designer blends words, pictures and colour on a computer for an advert. Which sub-specialization is this?
test.why: Computer graphics blends words, images and colour to deliver messages.

notes.text: The stream paragraph names only six of the eight areas; Language and Social Sciences and Performing and Visual Arts are not placed in a stream by the book.
Activity 3 (COVID-19 advice) is not answered in the book; the items use standard health advice. Teacher to confirm.
Activities 1–4 are open questions; they are asked as choices or "tap every" items with model answers.
